acceptance_criteria.criterion: Export produces a versioned manifest and deterministic records for memories, metadata, relationships, and Paperless references.
The portable bundle contains no credentials or document binaries.
Restore into an empty test store recreates the exported semantic graph without duplicate creation on rerun.
Round-trip verification reports record, relationship, and content-hash integrity.
